snippet.title: Trailer Of Maya : Ek Pishachini A New Indian Horror Game | PC Survival Indian Horror Game
snippet.description:
#horrorgame #horrorgameplay #horrorgaming #indiangame

🔥 Trailer of Maya: Ek Pishachini | New Indian PC Survival Horror Game 🔥

Step into the haunting world of Maya: Ek Pishachini, an upcoming Indian survival horror game inspired by chilling folklore and atmospheric storytelling. This terrifying PC horror experience blends cinematic visuals, tense exploration, and a spine-tingling narrative that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

About the Game

Maya: Ek Pishachini is a story-rich Hindi cinematic horror game (with English subtitles).
Five friends are traveling at midnight when they decide to take a shortcut—one that leads them straight to an abandoned mansion cursed by a Pishachini named Maya. Their car mysteriously breaks down near the mansion, and one by one, your friends disappear into the darkness.

You are the last one left.
Your mission: survive the horrors, uncover the secrets of Maya, and rescue your missing friends before it’s too late.

 Key Features

✅ Deep Indian-folklore–inspired horror experience
✅ Survival mechanics with exploration, stealth, and puzzles
✅ Dark, atmospheric environments and unsettling sound design
✅ Intense chase sequences & story-driven twists
✅ Full Hindi voice experience with English subtitles

Platform

PC (Windows)
Genre: Indian Horror / Survival Horror

Get It on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4069100/Maya__Ek_Pishachini/

Pre Register Maya : Ek Pishachini On PlayStore - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.akshatsoftwares.mayaekpishachini&hl=en
